topReviews.title: Data Scientists
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Chosen practical numerical comparisons, error checking and small-program debugging provide a coherent bridge to computational analysis that informs a decision. This supports a data-science introduction without requiring statistics courses or large datasets first; it does not prove a commitment to every analytical method.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to compare a small public dataset, check possible errors and explain a finding, or would you prefer a programming or price-comparison task?

topReviews.title: Carpenters
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Supervised gate repair, precise measurement and enjoyment of practical making support trying measurement and assembly in construction. Wood is a new material, but the underlying chosen activity is sufficiently close for exploration; no completed carpentry course or professional work is required.
topReviews.followup: Would you choose a short woodworking/joint-fitting task, a metal repair, or a comparison of both?

topReviews.title: Construction Laborers
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Hands-on maintenance, outdoor practical activity and supervised structural repair support a construction-team introduction. Site preparation and material handling are untested routines to preview, not grounds to reject the direction or infer present readiness.
topReviews.quote: Across 2024 and 2025, Lucia repaired a gate with supervision and organized a voter-registration information table for adults.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to see a team prepare a small build area and place materials, compare that with precise bench repair, or leave the site-work part open?

topReviews.title: Industrial designers
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Miniatures, prop work and a prospective design course support physical creative-design discovery. Designing an object around an everyday user’s needs is not yet clearly chosen apart from constructing a coherent fictional scene. Clarify that distinctive product goal rather than treating careful model assembly as automatic industrial-design support. Anxiety and new software are not the issue.
topReviews.followup: Would you enjoy making and revising an object to solve someone’s everyday problem, building a miniature story-world, or comparing those goals?

topReviews.title: Industrial Machinery Mechanics
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Repeated mechanical diagnosis, careful adjustment and precise bench work support learning to troubleshoot and maintain larger machinery. Seeking unfamiliar equipment is additional positive evidence; professional scale and safety training are future learning requirements, not prior-interest gates.
topReviews.followup: Would you like a supervised demonstration tracing a fault in a production machine, a bicycle mechanism, or both before comparing training routes?

topReviews.title: Special Effects Artists and Animators
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Character voices, recorded sound editing and a deliberately controlled puppet scene support developing moving character stories and their timing. Animation is a reasonable medium transfer from this combination; lack of software experience does not make the learning interest unsupported.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to animate a brief character action, stage it with a physical puppet, edit its sound, or compare those parts?

topReviews.title: Photographers
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Room sketches and close observation support visual exploration. The biography does not yet distinguish an interest in camera composition, light and reviewing photographs from pleasure in drawing remembered details. Keep photography available, but ask about the medium instead of converting visual memory into a settled camera-work preference.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to portray the same ordinary room through photographs and light changes, through drawing, or try both before reacting?

topReviews.title: Construction Laborers
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Chosen restoration, patient surface preparation and interest in continued woodworking support an introduction to practical construction/repair with tools. A larger site and team are unfamiliar context, but do not erase the reasonable task transfer; this is not a claim about shift tolerance or occupational skill.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to compare restoring an object, helping prepare and repair part of a structure, and handling materials for a team?

topReviews.title: Geoscientists
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Repeated coastal curiosity supports environmental and marine-science discovery. Rocks, sediment, landforms and Earth history are a more distinctive subject than shoreline debris, tide-pool organisms or visitor explanations; the current inference does not settle which coast-related questions he wants to pursue.
topReviews.followup: Would you choose investigating how rocks and sediment shape a shore, studying its organisms or debris, or comparing those questions?

topReviews.title: Statisticians
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Algebra, quantity records and systematic recipe changes justify a quantitative-method introduction. The main chosen inquiry is physics and understanding physical effects; analyzing variable data and judging sampling/uncertainty are not yet distinct preferences. Ask about statistical questions without requiring prior statistics or treating record keeping as a career wish.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to analyze repeated bread or farm measurements and judge how uncertain a pattern is, work through a physics explanation, or compare both?

topReviews.title: Carpenters
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Repair measurements, safe cutting preparation, useful-object making and actively seeking tool demonstrations support learning construction measurement and assembly in another material. Woodwork is a reasonable exploratory transfer; accessible instructions and reading pace affect the introduction, not whether the subject may interest her.
topReviews.quote: She learned to measure pipe beside her father on small repairs, checking numbers aloud before cutting.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to measure and assemble a simple wooden joint, continue a pipe repair, make a ceramic object, or compare these tasks using accessible instructions?

topReviews.title: Librarians & media specialists
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Chosen source organization, audience-sensitive notices and pleasure in finding clear explanations support helping people locate and understand reliable information. Library service is a reasonable application of that stated goal; no reference-desk experience is required to explore it.
topReviews.followup: Would you enjoy helping someone find reliable sources for their question, investigating your own topic, or comparing both roles in a short library exercise?

topReviews.title: HVAC technicians
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Mechanical fault tracing and checking repairs support a technical-service introduction. The stated alternatives are vehicle and production machinery; choosing heating/cooling installation, airflow/refrigeration problems and associated electrical checks is a distinct system goal still unresolved. Ask about that system rather than requiring professional HVAC experience or rejecting unfamiliar work.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to compare a heating/cooling fault demonstration with a vehicle or production-machine fault, and which problem would you choose to learn next?

topReviews.title: Light Truck Drivers
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Routes, delivery accuracy, an explicit transport-training comparison and attraction to movement/independence jointly support a delivery-driving introduction. Driving and full-shift conditions remain genuinely untested but need not already be experienced to support learning interest; licensing belongs in separate planning.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to learn about a delivery day involving driving and stops, compare it with route planning off the road, or try an observation of both?

topReviews.title: Graphic Designers
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Photographs, captions and collaborative news editing support audience-facing visual publication work. Graphic design is a reasonable extension into layout and visual revision, without assuming existing client-production competence. This original holdout observation is evaluation-only.
topReviews.followup: Would you prefer arranging photographs and captions into a clear page, producing the photographs, writing the story, or comparing these tasks?

topReviews.title: Writers & authors
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Repeated interview preparation, factual captions and editing school news support learning written reporting and reader-focused revision. Longer prose is new scope, not a reason to deny the writing direction. This original holdout observation is evaluation-only.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to turn an interview into a longer written story, an image-and-caption feature, or an audio piece before choosing what to develop?

topReviews.title: Historians
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Interest in different accounts of the same past event, interviewing relatives and revising consent procedures provide direct oral-history evidence. Historical inquiry is a reasonable learning direction; broader archives and unfamiliar periods can be introduced without requiring professional research. This original holdout observation is evaluation-only.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to compare accounts of an unfamiliar past event using interviews and documents, continue a family audio history, or try both?

topReviews.title: Fine Artists, Including Painters, Sculptors, and Illustrators
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Chosen material patterns, patient revision and completed personal gifts support artistic object-making. Broader media and artistic presentation remain to be explored, but neither a professional portfolio nor painting experience is required for this creative direction. This original holdout observation is evaluation-only.
topReviews.followup: Would you enjoy developing an original textile piece for its visual meaning, making useful gifts, exploring another art material, or comparing those aims?

topReviews.title: Writers & authors
topReviews.label: supported
topReviews.reason: Original stories, imaginative labels, interview production and separating fact from fictional voice support writing and narrative revision. Long prose is a possible new form rather than a prerequisite; the desire for accurate shared credit is positive evidence. This original holdout observation is evaluation-only.
topReviews.quote: Telling an accurate and engaging story
topReviews.followup: Would you choose revising a written story, shaping an interview script, narrating someone else’s text, or comparing those activities?

topReviews.title: Physics Teachers, Postsecondary
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: There is strong evidence of chosen explanatory work and positive experience explaining density. Sustained study of physics as the subject of a college course, rather than choosing examples that help familiar peers, remains unresolved. Offer subject depth and course-design/feedback examples; do not demand a graduate degree or prior laboratory supervision before exploration.
topReviews.quote: Finding a second example when the first explanation fails
topReviews.followup: Would you like to study a less familiar physics idea in depth and plan how to teach and check it, or is improving an explanation across different subjects more appealing?

topReviews.title: Atmospheric, Earth, Marine, and Space Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary
topReviews.label: needs-clarification
topReviews.reason: Weather diagrams and a rain explanation support Earth-science education discovery. Whether she wants sustained atmospheric/Earth inquiry and teaching a whole subject, beyond finding a helpful short example, is still open. Adult-course assessment is also a distinctive responsibility to preview; autism, preparation needs and dislike of task allocation are not automatic exclusions.
topReviews.followup: Would you like to investigate a new weather question and build a short lesson with a way to check understanding, compare that with another science topic, or leave the subject open?
